# r17 two-console LAN list (generated by gen_kit.py from sitting.py). ONLY if the owner has a second Vita; not part of r17-sitting.txt.
# Both consoles on the same Wi-Fi as the Mac: export VITA_IP=<first Vita> VITA_IP2=<second Vita>; each leg is `bash session.sh lan <leg>` (about 4 min a leg). Radio / Nearby runs and the by-hand items are in CONSOLE-PLAN-r17.md.
lan	lan-base	LAN match, the game's own input delay
lan	lan-auto	LAN match, MSC_LAN_INPUT_DELAY=auto (host)
lan	lan-simt-both	LAN match, MSC_SIMT=2 on both consoles (MSC_SIMT_LAN=1)
lan	lan-simt-host	LAN match, MSC_SIMT=2 on the host console only (MSC_SIMT_LAN=1)
